why: PR #664 declared three constructionVariants on es-b1-reported-speech. Both cells sat at target (cloze 49/50, translation 50/50), so the scheduler generated nothing and the rotation was inert. These 50 rows are the OLDEST 25 per cell among the rows labelled `past-report-imperfect-backshift` by the variant-seed backfill (artifact: es-b1-reported-speech-variant-seeds-2026-08-18.json) — they are over-represented, NOT defective.
reasonRationale: pool-hygiene and duplicate leave learner scores untouched. `quality` and `learner-flag` are NON_EVIDENCE_DEMOTION_REASONS and would silently revoke learners' credit for every past attempt on these rows, requiring `backfill:mastery --apply` to recover. Nothing here is defective, so pool-hygiene is correct and no mastery rebuild is needed.
command: pnpm --filter @language-drill/db demote:pool --language ES --cefr B1 --type <cloze|translation> --grammar-point es-b1-reported-speech --content-ilike '"seedWord": "past-report-imperfect-backshift"' --limit 25 --reason pool-hygiene --apply
contentIlikeNote: The content filter is what keeps the single `present-report-command-subjunctive` cloze and the unlabelled indirect-question cloze (seedWord 'what', owned by es-b1-indirect-questions) in the pool — a bare --limit 25 selects oldest-first with no variant filter and would have swept the command row.
